ayurveda-spa.title: India Ayurveda / Spa Tour
ayurveda-spa.metaDescription: Plan India Ayurveda and spa holidays with Vivance Travels—Kerala wellness resorts and guided health-focused itineraries.
ayurveda-spa.description: Ayurveda is a traditional Indian system of wellness focused on balance in daily life, diet and therapies. Vivance Travels connects travellers with reputable spa and Ayurveda stays, especially in Kerala and other southern states.

sections.text: Mind, body and daily rhythm
If you want a holiday that also supports rest and recovery, India offers wellness resorts alongside cultural sightseeing. Ayurveda-led programmes are among the most established options.
Reputed centres assess your needs before recommending therapies, diet guidance and rest schedules. We help you choose stays that match light rejuvenation or longer treatment goals.

The word Ayurveda comes from Sanskrit roots linked to life and knowledge. In practice, programmes emphasise routine, herbal preparations and therapist-led treatments under clinical supervision at quality centres.
How programmes are framed
Modern schedules often leave little room for recovery. Many Ayurveda approaches begin with cleansing and balancing routines before maintenance therapies—always follow the centre’s medical advice.
What resorts typically offer
Spa menus may include massages, steam, herbal applications and hydrotherapy. Share any medical conditions in advance so the resort can advise what is appropriate.
Common therapies you may encounter
Treatments commonly use plant oils, herbal powders and time-tested techniques. Choose centres with qualified therapists rather than only the lowest price.
Therapies often listed in classical programmes

Panchakarma refers to a set of purification-oriented therapies aimed at balancing doshas (often described as Vata, Pitta and Kapha). It should only be undertaken at centres equipped for proper assessment.
Abhyanga-style oil massage is often performed by trained therapists using prescribed herbal oils. It is one of the most familiar entry points for first-time wellness travellers.
Udvartana uses herbal powders in a firmer massage style and is sometimes chosen in weight-management or invigorating programmes.
Podikizhi uses warm herbal pouches for a deeper, heat-assisted massage that many guests find helpful for stiffness—suitability depends on individual assessment.
Njavara kizhi uses linen pouches with specially prepared rice in restorative programmes. Centres will confirm whether it fits your plan.
Oil-based gargling therapies are traditionally used in some ENT-focused protocols. Only undertake these under therapist guidance.
Therapeutic emesis protocols exist within classical frameworks for specific conditions and are not casual spa add-ons. Medical screening is essential.
Purgative protocols using prescribed herbal preparations are similarly clinical in intent. They belong in supervised programmes, not walk-in menus.

Kerala remains India’s best-known region for Ayurveda holidays thanks to climate, herb availability and a dense network of wellness resorts. Many travellers combine light therapies with backwater or hill stays.
Quality Ayurveda and spa options also appear in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra and other states. We prioritise hygiene standards, therapist credentials and clear programme outlines.

Beach shacks, live music and seasonal events keep evenings social if you want them. Quieter resorts inland or in the south suit travellers seeking calm.

Markets sell cotton wear, spices, cashews and crafts—quality varies, so compare a few shops. Keep beach days flexible around rest.
Seafood and Goan curries are highlights; try local fish thalis and sample feni only if it suits you. Share dietary needs when we book restaurants or hotels.

Assam is the Brahmaputra valley gateway to the north-east, known for tea estates and one-horned rhinoceros habitat in protected parks.

Here are the top attractions of Andaman and Nicobar Islands:
Port Blair

Port Blair is the practical gateway to the islands and a thoughtful first stop for history and orientation. The Cellular Jail memorial and waterfront walks give useful context before you head to quieter beaches.
Havelock Islands

Havelock (Swaraj Dweep) is known for soft sand and excellent swimming conditions, especially around Radhanagar Beach. Dive and snorkel operators here make it simple to explore reefs without a long learning curve.
Baratang Island
Baratang is best experienced by boat, with mangrove channels and limestone formations that feel far from the main towns. Day trips work well when you want scenery without changing hotels.
Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep) suits travellers who prefer a calmer shoreline and clear shallows for casual snorkelling. Sunrise and sunset points are easy to reach on foot or by local transport.
Ross Island (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Island) preserves colonial-era ruins set among deer and banyan trees. It is a short boat ride from Port Blair and pairs well with a half-day heritage circuit.

Rangat and the Middle Andaman stretch offer quieter beaches such as Cuthbert Bay, where turtle nesting seasons add seasonal interest. Staying overnight here helps you avoid rushing long road transfers.
Island kitchens lean on fresh seafood, coconut and simple tropical fruit. Ask for locally caught fish grilled with mild spices rather than only mainland-style curries.
Markets in Port Blair stock shell crafts, spices and light cotton wear. Choose certified vendors if you buy shell products and respect marine protection rules.
December to April usually brings the most reliable sea conditions for swimming and ferry schedules. Monsoon months can disrupt sailings, so build buffer days into island itineraries.
How To Reach

Most visitors fly into Veer Savarkar International Airport at Port Blair, with connections from major Indian cities. Ferries link Port Blair with Havelock and Neil; limited passenger ships also operate from mainland ports on longer schedules.

Here are the top places to visit in Andhra Pradesh:
Visakhapatnam
Visakhapatnam combines a working harbour with hillside viewpoints and a string of urban beaches. Araku Valley day trips add coffee estates and cooler air when you want a break from the coast.
Tirupati

Tirupati draws pilgrims to the Venkateswara temple in the Tirumala hills and remains one of India's most visited spiritual centres. Surrounding shrines and Talakona falls give other travellers extra reasons to linger.
Vijayawada
Vijayawada sits on the Krishna River and is known for cave temples such as Undavalli and the long Prakasam Barrage promenade. Museums and Kondapalli fort add compact heritage stops for a short stay.
Nellore's countryside is defined by paddy fields and birdlife at reserves such as Nelapattu. Forts at Udayagiri and Venkatagiri suit travellers who enjoy quieter historic sites.
Chittoor district offers Horsley Hills for a short hill break and forested tracts around Kaundinya for wildlife drives. Temple circuits here link naturally with a Tirupati-focused journey.
Andhra meals are known for bold chilli heat, tangy tamarind gravies and generous rice plates. Seafood along the coast and millet-based dishes inland keep menus varied.
Look for handloom cotton, Kondapalli toys and temple souvenirs in local markets. Many routes also pass shops selling regional sweets and spice mixes worth packing carefully.
October to February is the most comfortable window for sightseeing. Summers are hot on the plains, while monsoon months bring heavy but uneven rain.
How to Reach

Domestic airports at Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Tirupati and Rajahmundry cover most tourist circuits. Rail links are strong along the coast; road journeys connect temple towns efficiently with a private driver.

arunachal-pradesh.metaDescription: Explore Arunachal Pradesh with Vivance Travels—Tawang monastery, Itanagar and eastern Himalayan landscapes on a guided holiday.
arunachal-pradesh.description: Arunachal Pradesh rises where the eastern Himalaya meets thick forest, high passes and quiet monastery towns. Vivance Travels plans permits, pacing and mountain transfers so your north-east journey stays comfortable and well timed.

sections.text: Arunachal Pradesh rises where the eastern Himalaya meets thick forest, high passes and quiet monastery towns. Vivance Travels plans permits, pacing and mountain transfers so your north-east journey stays comfortable and well timed.
Here are the top places to visit in Arunachal Pradesh:
Tawang

Tawang sits at high altitude with wide mountain views and the historic Tawang Monastery as its spiritual centrepiece. The drive over Sela Pass is scenic but demanding, so we schedule rest stops and weather buffers.
Roing
Roing and the lower Dibang valley open into greener, less-visited countryside with rivers and tribal villages. It is a good counterpoint if you want nature time beyond the main monastery circuit.
Itanagar

Itanagar, the state capital, works as an arrival hub with museums and local markets that introduce Arunachal's cultural mix. Use it for permit formalities and a gentler first night before longer hill drives.
Expect simple mountain food—momos, thukpa, smoked meats and fresh vegetables—alongside Assamese influences in larger towns. Carry snacks for long road days between valleys.
October to April is generally preferred for clearer views and more reliable roads. Always confirm inner-line permits and local advisories before travel.
How to Reach

Flights typically arrive via Guwahati or Dibrugarh in Assam, followed by road transfers into Arunachal. Shared sumos and private vehicles are the main options; distances look short on a map but take time in the hills.

assam.title: Assam
assam.metaDescription: Visit Assam with Vivance Travels—Kaziranga wildlife, Guwahati, tea estates and Brahmaputra journeys planned around your dates.
assam.description: Assam is the gateway to much of north-east India, known for the Brahmaputra, tea estates and one-horned rhinoceros habitat. Vivance Travels combines wildlife, river views and tea-country stays into clear, unhurried itineraries.

sections.text: Assam is the gateway to much of north-east India, known for the Brahmaputra, tea estates and one-horned rhinoceros habitat. Vivance Travels combines wildlife, river views and tea-country stays into clear, unhurried itineraries.
Here are the top places to visit in Assam:
Guwahati

Guwahati is the main air and rail hub, with the Kamakhya temple and riverfront walks as easy first introductions to the state. It is also the practical base for onward journeys into other north-eastern states.
Jorhat
Jorhat sits among classic tea country and is a convenient springboard for Majuli island and upper Assam heritage. Estate visits help you understand how Assam tea is grown and processed.
Sualkuchi
Sualkuchi is renowned for Assamese silk weaving, especially muga and pat fabrics. A short stop here is ideal if you want authentic textiles without a full shopping day in the city.

Kaziranga and other protected areas are the highlight for wildlife travellers, especially for rhinoceros sightings in the cooler months. Jeep safaris work best with early starts and flexible park-gate timing.
Tea gardens around Dibrugarh and Jorhat offer quiet bungalow stays and cycling lanes between orderly rows of bushes. Morning mist over the estates is a favourite photo moment.
Assamese thalis feature rice, fish curries, greens and tangy pickles, with duck and pork dishes common in many homes. Try local rice beer only from trusted sources if it interests you.
Guwahati markets sell Assam silk, tea packets and bamboo crafts. Buy silk from reputed weavers' outlets when possible to support local artisans.
Bihu festivals and Vaishnavite satras on Majuli show a living cultural calendar beyond sightseeing lists. Time your visit if you enjoy music and community celebrations.
Weather Conditions
November to April is the prime wildlife and touring season. Monsoon rains can flood low-lying roads, so summer and peak monsoon need more flexible plans.
How to Reach
Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport in Guwahati handles most arrivals. Trains and national highways link the Brahmaputra valley; river ferries add character on selected routes.

bihar.title: Bihar
bihar.metaDescription: Travel Bihar with Vivance Travels—Bodh Gaya, Nalanda, Patna heritage and thoughtfully paced pilgrimage holidays.
bihar.description: Bihar holds deep significance for Buddhist and Jain travellers and offers layered history around Patna, Gaya and Nalanda. Vivance Travels focuses on pilgrimage pacing, comfortable stays and clear road plans across the plains.

sections.text: Bihar holds deep significance for Buddhist and Jain travellers and offers layered history around Patna, Gaya and Nalanda. Vivance Travels focuses on pilgrimage pacing, comfortable stays and clear road plans across the plains.
Here are the top places to visit in Bihar:
Gaya
Gaya and Bodh Gaya form the spiritual heart of many itineraries, centred on the Mahabodhi Temple complex. Early morning visits help you experience the site before larger crowds arrive.
Nalanda
Nalanda's excavated university ruins and nearby Rajgir hills suit travellers interested in ancient learning and quiet walks. A guide makes the archaeological layout easier to follow.
Munger
Munger, on the Ganga, is known for its fort area and yoga traditions. It works as a calmer stop if you are linking eastern Bihar towns by road.
Patna anchors most journeys with museums, river ghats and practical flight connections. Golghar and the city's older quarters add short heritage walks between longer temple days.
Bihari food is hearty—litti chokha, sattu drinks and simple vegetarian thalis are widely available. Street snacks are best chosen from busy, well-turned stalls.
Handicrafts include Madhubani-inspired art prints, stonework and religious souvenirs near pilgrimage centres. Pack flat items carefully for air travel.
The state's cultural calendar mixes Hindu festivals with major Buddhist gatherings. Check local event dates if you want a quieter temple visit or, conversely, a festival atmosphere.
October to March is the most comfortable period on the plains. Summers are intense; monsoon months can slow road travel.
How to Reach
Patna's airport and rail junctions connect Bihar to Delhi, Kolkata and other metros. Private cars are the most efficient way to link Bodh Gaya, Rajgir and Nalanda in one circuit.

chandigarh.title: Chandigarh
chandigarh.metaDescription: Enjoy Chandigarh with Vivance Travels—Rock Garden, Sukhna Lake, Capitol Complex and easy north-India city breaks.
chandigarh.description: Chandigarh is India's best-known planned city, set against the Shivalik foothills with generous gardens and modernist architecture. Vivance Travels uses it as a relaxed base for city walks and short hill getaways.

sections.text: Chandigarh is India's best-known planned city, set against the Shivalik foothills with generous gardens and modernist architecture. Vivance Travels uses it as a relaxed base for city walks and short hill getaways.
Here are the top places to visit in Chandigarh:
Rock Garden
The Rock Garden is a large open-air creation built from recycled materials, with courtyards and pathways that reward an unhurried visit. Go earlier in the day for softer light and fewer groups.
Rose Garden
Zakir Hussain Rose Garden is one of Asia's larger rose gardens and is especially colourful in peak bloom months. It pairs well with other leisurely park stops in the same sector.
Sukhna Lake
Sukhna Lake is the city's favourite evening promenade, with boating and mountain views on clear days. Sunrise walks here are quieter if you prefer a calmer pace.
Le Corbusier's Capitol Complex, including the High Court and Assembly buildings, is a landmark of modern architecture. Guided access rules apply, so we arrange timings in advance when needed.
Chandigarh's food scene mixes Punjabi classics with café culture in the sectors. Sector 17 and nearby markets make casual dining easy between sights.
Shopping leans toward boutiques, bookstores and regional textiles rather than heavy souvenir bazaars. It is a convenient place to pick up practical travel items before hill journeys.
October to March is ideal for outdoor sightseeing. Summers are hot, though evenings can still be pleasant for lake walks.
Day trips toward Pinjore Gardens or the lower Himalayan foothills fit neatly into a Chandigarh stay. Many travellers continue to Shimla or Himachal circuits from here.
How to Reach Chandigarh
Chandigarh International Airport and a well-connected railway station serve the city. Local taxis and app cabs cover the sector grid efficiently.

chhattisgarh.title: Chhattisgarh
chhattisgarh.metaDescription: Discover Chhattisgarh with Vivance Travels—Chitrakote Falls, wildlife reserves, tribal heritage and custom central-India tours.
chhattisgarh.description: Chhattisgarh is a central-Indian state of forests, waterfalls and living tribal traditions that still feel under-visited. Vivance Travels builds nature-led holidays with realistic drive times between parks and falls.

sections.text: Chhattisgarh is a central-Indian state of forests, waterfalls and living tribal traditions that still feel under-visited. Vivance Travels builds nature-led holidays with realistic drive times between parks and falls.
Here are the top places to visit in Chhattisgarh:
Chitrakot Waterfall
Chitrakote Falls on the Indravati River is often compared to a horseshoe cascade and is most dramatic after good rainfall. Viewpoints on both banks give different perspectives for photography.
Kawardha Palace
Kawardha and its palace hotel heritage appeal to travellers who enjoy quieter royal-era stays. The surrounding countryside is ideal for slow evenings after forest drives.
Achanakumar Wildlife Sanctuary
Achanakmar Tiger Reserve offers forested safari terrain with a chance of spotting big cats and rich birdlife. Park rules and seasonal closures should guide your dates.
Village visits, when arranged respectfully through local partners, introduce crafts, music and everyday forest-edge life. We avoid intrusive schedules and prioritise community-approved experiences.
Beyond Achanakmar, reserves and buffer forests support gaur, deer and diverse bird species. Early morning game drives are usually the most productive.
Cuisine features rice, forest greens, tribal recipes and straightforward vegetarian thalis in towns. Carry drinking water on longer waterfall day trips.
Look for bell metal work, bamboo items and handwoven fabrics in Raipur and craft outlets. Buying directly from cooperative stores helps ensure fair pricing.
Other falls such as Tirathgarh add variety if you are touring Bastar. Trails can be slippery in wet months, so footwear matters.
November to February is comfortable for wildlife and road travel. Monsoon turns the landscape lush but can limit safari access.
Allow buffer time between remote falls and park gates; distances are moderate but road quality varies. A private vehicle is strongly recommended.
How to Reach Chhattisgarh
Raipur's Swami Vivekananda Airport is the main air gateway, with rail links across central India. Road journeys fan out toward Bastar, Kawardha and the northern districts.

dadra-and-nagar-haveli.title: Dadra and Nagar Haveli
dadra-and-nagar-haveli.metaDescription: Visit Dadra and Nagar Haveli with Vivance Travels—lake gardens, forest walks and easy western-India weekend style holidays.
dadra-and-nagar-haveli.description: Dadra and Nagar Haveli is a compact union territory of lakes, gardens and forested pockets between Gujarat and Maharashtra. Vivance Travels treats it as a calm nature break rather than a rushed checklist destination.

sections.text: Dadra and Nagar Haveli is a compact union territory of lakes, gardens and forested pockets between Gujarat and Maharashtra. Vivance Travels treats it as a calm nature break rather than a rushed checklist destination.
Here are the top places to visit in Dadra and Nagar Haveli:
Vanganga Lake Garden
Vanganga Lake Garden is a landscaped lakeside space popular for relaxed walks and family outings. It is an easy introduction to the territory's quieter character.
Hirwa Van Garden
Hirwa Van Garden offers shaded paths and seasonal planting that work well in the cooler hours of the day. Pair it with nearby viewpoints if you want a fuller outdoor morning.
Dudhni Lake
Dudhni Lake is the highlight for many visitors, with boating and surrounding greenery that feel removed from larger cities. Sunset light on the water is especially appealing.
Meals are simple—Gujarati and Maharashtrian influences appear on most menus. Lakeside snack stalls are fine for light bites when crowds are active.
October to March is the most pleasant period for gardens and lake time. Weekdays are quieter than holiday weekends if you prefer space on the paths.

daman-and-diu.title: Daman and Diu
daman-and-diu.metaDescription: Explore Daman and Diu with Vivance Travels—forts, churches, beaches and Portuguese-era coastal heritage holidays.
daman-and-diu.description: Daman and Diu preserve a coastal blend of beaches, forts and Portuguese-era churches on India's west coast. Vivance Travels shapes short coastal breaks that mix heritage walks with time on the sand.

sections.text: Daman and Diu preserve a coastal blend of beaches, forts and Portuguese-era churches on India's west coast. Vivance Travels shapes short coastal breaks that mix heritage walks with time on the sand.
Here are the top places to visit in Daman and Diu:
Fort Jerome
Diu's fortifications, including the main fort overlooking the sea, are the territory's signature historic landmark. Rampart walks are best in the morning before the stone heats up.
Bom Jesus Church
Churches such as St. Paul's and other Portuguese-period buildings give Diu a distinct architectural character. Modest dress is appreciated inside active places of worship.
Zampa Gateway
Zampa Gateway and older town gates mark the historic approaches into Diu's old quarters. They make natural photo stops while you wander between cafés and fort walls.
Beaches around Diu and Daman range from lively stretches to quieter coves. Swimming conditions vary with tides and season—follow local advice on safer sections.
Whitewashed churches and chapels punctuate both Daman and Diu, reflecting centuries of coastal trade and colonial history. A guided heritage walk ties the sites together efficiently.
Seafood grills, simple Goan-influenced plates and Gujarati snacks appear across menus. Fresh catch of the day is usually the safest order near the harbour.
Pick up light cotton clothes, cashews and small handicrafts in town markets. Diu's compact centre is easy to cover on foot or by scooter where permitted.
Portuguese-era planning still shapes street layouts and fort-town relationships. Travellers interested in architecture will find more detail than a quick beach stop suggests.
November to February is ideal for sightseeing and beach time. Monsoon seas can be rough; summers are hot but manageable with early starts.
How to Reach
Diu has a small airport with limited connections; otherwise travellers route via Surat, Rajkot or Mumbai and continue by road. Ferries and bridges link island sections depending on your exact base.

delhi.title: Delhi
delhi.metaDescription: Tour Delhi with Vivance Travels—India Gate, Old Delhi, Qutub Minar, food walks and custom capital-city holiday plans.
delhi.description: Delhi layers Mughal monuments, colonial avenues and energetic neighbourhood markets into one capital-city experience. Vivance Travels sequences sights so you see the highlights without exhausting transfers.

sections.text: Delhi layers Mughal monuments, colonial avenues and energetic neighbourhood markets into one capital-city experience. Vivance Travels sequences sights so you see the highlights without exhausting transfers.
Here are the top places to visit in Delhi:
India Gate, Rajpath views and the broader Lutyens' zone introduce New Delhi's ceremonial core. Evening illumination makes this area especially photogenic.
Qutub Minar and Humayun's Tomb showcase early Indo-Islamic architecture with spacious gardens that reward slow exploration. Combined tickets and sensible ordering of sites save time.
Old Delhi's lanes around Chandni Chowk, Jama Masjid and the Red Fort are best explored with a guide and light walking shoes. Cycle rickshaw segments can reduce fatigue between stops.
South Delhi museums, craft boutiques and quieter residential markets balance the intensity of the old city. A half-day here suits travellers who want modern café culture too.
Food
From street chaat to refined regional restaurants, Delhi is one of India's great food cities. We can arrange focused food walks or reservation-led dining depending on your style.
Shopping
Shopping ranges from bazaars for spices and fabrics to emporiums for handicrafts from across India. Bargain politely in street markets and keep valuables secure in crowds.
Janpath, Khan Market and Dilli Haat offer different retail moods—from souvenirs to designer labels and state emporium crafts. Decide your priorities before you start to avoid overload.
How to Reach
Indira Gandhi International Airport connects Delhi worldwide, while an extensive metro and road network cover the city. For monument days, a private car remains the most comfortable option.

goa.title: Goa
goa.metaDescription: Book Goa holidays with Vivance Travels—Calangute, Baga, Anjuna, Old Goa churches and beach stays planned for you.
goa.description: Goa is India's favourite coastal escape, with palm-lined beaches, whitewashed churches and a relaxed café culture. Vivance Travels balances north-Goa energy with quieter south-Goa shores to match your travel style.

sections.text: Goa is India's favourite coastal escape, with palm-lined beaches, whitewashed churches and a relaxed café culture. Vivance Travels balances north-Goa energy with quieter south-Goa shores to match your travel style.
Here are the top places to visit in Goa:
Calangute Beach
Calangute is a central north-Goa beach with plentiful stays, water sports and easy access to neighbouring shores. It works well for first-time visitors who want conveniences close at hand.
Baga Beach
Baga sits beside Calangute and is known for a livelier evening scene and watersport operators. Families often prefer daytime beach hours and quieter dinners inland.
Anjuna Beach
Anjuna retains a more alternative reputation, with a well-known flea market and cliff-edged viewpoints. Sunsets from the higher rocks are a highlight when the sky is clear.
Old Goa's churches, including the Basilica of Bom Jesus, preserve important Christian heritage from the Portuguese period. Modest clothing is expected inside active churches.
Beyond the beaches, spice plantations and waterfall day trips such as Dudhsagar (seasonal access) add greenery to a coastal holiday. Road times vary with traffic and monsoon conditions.
Goan cuisine mixes seafood, coconut, vinegar-based curries and Portuguese-influenced breads. Try local fish thalis and save room for bebinca if you enjoy desserts.
Markets and beach shacks sell clothes, spices and cashews; quality varies, so compare a few stalls. South Goa boutiques often feel calmer than the busiest north-Goa strips.
November to March is peak season for beach weather and festive events. Monsoon transforms the landscape but limits swimming; shoulder months can offer better value.
How to Reach
Goa International Airport at Dabolim and the newer Mopa airport serve different parts of the state. Trains reach Madgaon and Thivim; private transfers are the simplest way to your beach hotel.

gujarat.title: Gujarat
gujarat.metaDescription: Explore Gujarat with Vivance Travels—Gir lions, Rani ki Vav, Dwarka, Kutch crafts and custom western-India holidays.
gujarat.description: Gujarat rewards travellers with stepwells, lion country, temple coasts and vibrant textile traditions. Vivance Travels links heritage cities with wildlife and craft experiences on realistic road itineraries.

sections.text: Gujarat rewards travellers with stepwells, lion country, temple coasts and vibrant textile traditions. Vivance Travels links heritage cities with wildlife and craft experiences on realistic road itineraries.
Beyond headline monuments, Gujarat's strength is variety—desert edges, coastal shrines and living craft towns in one state. We pace long drives so you arrive with energy for each stop.
Here are the top places to visit in Gujarat:
Rani Ki Vav, Patan
Rani ki Vav at Patan is a UNESCO-listed stepwell with intricate carvings best appreciated with a guide. Morning light helps photography in the deep corridors.
Gir National Park, Junagadh
Gir National Park is the only natural home of Asiatic lions and a highlight for wildlife travellers. Safari permits and seasonal park rules should shape your dates.
Dwarkadhish Temple
Dwarka's Dwarkadhish Temple is a major pilgrimage centre on the western shore. Combine temple time with a coastal walk if your schedule allows a calmer evening.
Somnath's shoreline temple is another key spiritual stop on the Saurashtra circuit. Sunset views over the Arabian Sea add atmosphere after darshan.
Ahmedabad offers old-city pols, museums and excellent food walks between longer road days. It is also the most practical air hub for many Gujarat itineraries.
Kutch is known for white desert landscapes near Dhordo and for embroidery, bandhani and bell-metal crafts in surrounding villages. Winter festival periods are especially lively.
The Statue of Unity near Kevadia works as a modern landmark day trip from central Gujarat routes. Book entry slots in advance during busy weekends.
Gujarati thalis, farsan snacks and sweet shops are a core part of the journey. Coastal towns add seafood options for non-vegetarian travellers.
Ahmedabad, Bhuj and smaller craft markets are ideal for textiles, block prints and jewellery. Buy from known cooperatives when you want traceable artisan work.
Navratri and other festivals transform cities with music and dance. If you travel in festival season, reserve stays early and expect lively nights.
Besides Gir, birding wetlands and seasonal landscapes broaden a nature-focused trip. Carry binoculars if wildlife is a priority.
October to March is the most comfortable touring window. Summers are hot inland; monsoon greens the countryside but can slow rural roads.
How to Reach
Ahmedabad, Surat, Rajkot, Vadodara and Bhuj airports cover most circuits. We match arrival airports to your first and last nights to cut backtracking.
Gujarat's rail network links major cities efficiently for travellers who prefer fewer road hours. Overnight trains can replace a full driving day on longer routes.
Private cars remain the best way to reach stepwells, parks and coastal temples on one itinerary. Highway quality is generally good between primary cities.

haryana.title: Haryana
haryana.metaDescription: Visit Haryana with Vivance Travels—Kurukshetra, Gurugram, birding wetlands and north-India stopovers planned for you.
haryana.description: Haryana sits on busy north-Indian routes yet still offers pilgrimage towns, birding wetlands and modern city breaks. Vivance Travels uses it for Kurukshetra heritage, Gurugram convenience and easy links to Delhi and Chandigarh.

sections.text: Haryana sits on busy north-Indian routes yet still offers pilgrimage towns, birding wetlands and modern city breaks. Vivance Travels uses it for Kurukshetra heritage, Gurugram convenience and easy links to Delhi and Chandigarh.
Here are the top places to visit in Haryana:
Chandigarh
Areas around Chandigarh and Panchkula give access to gardens and foothill day trips without a long mountain transfer. They work well at the start or end of a Himachal journey.
Gurgaon
Gurugram is a modern business city with malls, international dining and comfortable hotels. Travellers often use it as a practical overnight before early flights from Delhi.
Kurukshetra
Kurukshetra is tied to the Mahabharata tradition, with tanks, temples and museums that explain the region's epic associations. A guided visit helps prioritise the most meaningful stops.
Sultanpur National Park and similar wetlands attract birders in winter when migratory species arrive. Carry binoculars and visit in the cooler morning hours.
Haryanvi and Punjabi flavours dominate menus—fresh breads, dairy-rich dishes and simple vegetarian thalis. Highway dhabas are part of the regional road culture.
Shopping is strongest in Gurugram's malls and in town markets for everyday goods rather than specialist crafts. Pick up snacks and travel essentials before hill journeys.
October to March is best for outdoor sites and birding. Summers are hot on the plains.
How to Reach
Delhi and Chandigarh airports are the usual gateways, with a dense highway and rail grid across the state. Private transfers make multi-stop days straightforward.

himachal-pradesh.title: Himachal Pradesh
himachal-pradesh.metaDescription: Holiday in Himachal Pradesh with Vivance Travels—Shimla, Manali, Kullu valleys and custom mountain getaways.
himachal-pradesh.description: Himachal Pradesh is classic Himalayan holiday country—pine forests, colonial hill towns and deep river valleys. Vivance Travels plans altitude-aware itineraries across Shimla, Kullu-Manali and quieter districts.

sections.text: Himachal Pradesh is classic Himalayan holiday country—pine forests, colonial hill towns and deep river valleys. Vivance Travels plans altitude-aware itineraries across Shimla, Kullu-Manali and quieter districts.
Here are the top places to visit in Himachal Pradesh:
Kullu
Kullu valley is the approach to many mountain holidays, with river views and orchard country along the Beas. It is a scenic base before higher Manali stays.
Manali and nearby villages offer snow in winter, meadow walks in summer and a wide choice of stays. We advise on Rohtang or Atal Tunnel day plans according to permits and season.
Shimla
Shimla retains its ridge promenade, colonial architecture and toy-train nostalgia for many families. Early mornings on the Mall are calmer than midday crowds.
Chamba
Chamba and the surrounding hills feel less commercial, with historic temples and wide valley views. It suits travellers who want Himachal beyond the busiest resorts.
Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj add Tibetan cultural notes, monastery visits and trails with Kangra valley panoramas. Weather can change quickly at these elevations.
Himachali dham-style meals, siddu and simple mountain thalis appear in homestays and local restaurants. Carry water and light snacks on longer valley drives.
March to June and September to November are popular for clear views and comfortable days. Winter brings snow to higher towns—beautiful, but pack for cold and possible road delays.
How to Reach
Airports at Bhuntar (Kullu), Gaggal (Kangra) and Chandigarh serve different circuits. Most travellers still rely on road transfers; we build realistic drive times into every plan.

jammu-and-kashmir.title: Jammu and Kashmir
jammu-and-kashmir.metaDescription: Experience Kashmir and Ladakh with Vivance Travels—Srinagar houseboats, Gulmarg, Leh and custom Himalayan holidays.
jammu-and-kashmir.description: Jammu and Kashmir and the wider Himalayan region offer lakes, meadows, pilgrimage routes and high-altitude desert landscapes toward Ladakh. Vivance Travels sequences stays carefully for weather, permits and acclimatisation.

sections.text: Jammu and Kashmir and the wider Himalayan region offer lakes, meadows, pilgrimage routes and high-altitude desert landscapes toward Ladakh. Vivance Travels sequences stays carefully for weather, permits and acclimatisation.
Here are the top places to visit in Jammu and Kashmir:
Srinagar
Srinagar is centred on Dal Lake, Mughal gardens and a distinctive houseboat stay tradition. Shikara rides at sunrise or dusk are among the region's most memorable moments.
Leh
Leh opens the high-altitude world of monasteries, stark mountains and clear desert light. We build in rest on arrival so you adjust before longer day trips.
Jammu City
Jammu city is the usual rail and winter-road gateway, with temples such as Raghunath as short cultural stops. Many travellers pass through en route to Kashmir or Vaishno Devi.
Gulmarg and Pahalgam provide meadow landscapes, Gondola views and river-side walks depending on season. They are ideal extensions from a Srinagar base.
Kashmiri wazwan flavours, noon chai and bakery breads define local food culture. In Leh, expect Tibetan-influenced soups, noodles and hearty vegetarian plates.
Houseboats on Dal or Nigeen lakes offer a stay style unique to the region when water levels and regulations allow. We select maintained boats with reliable service standards.
Look for pashmina, papier-mâché and saffron from reputable shops—ask about authenticity and pricing before you buy. Bargaining is normal in tourist markets.
Summer suits most first-time visitors for open roads and garden blooms. Spring and autumn can be superb for lighter crowds and crisp views.
Winter transforms Gulmarg into a snow destination while some high passes close. Pack layers and confirm road status if you travel between December and February.
Craft traditions, Sufi heritage and Himalayan Buddhist culture coexist across the wider region. A balanced itinerary samples more than one of these threads.
How to Reach
Srinagar and Jammu airports handle Kashmir circuits; Leh has its own high-altitude airport. Road journeys over mountain passes need flexible timing and experienced drivers.

jharkhand.title: Jharkhand
jharkhand.metaDescription: Discover Jharkhand with Vivance Travels—Ranchi waterfalls, Deoghar pilgrimage and eastern-India nature breaks.
jharkhand.description: Jharkhand is a mineral-rich state of forests, waterfalls and pilgrimage centres that remains less crowded than many Indian holiday belts. Vivance Travels focuses on Ranchi, Deoghar and nature stops with practical road plans.

sections.text: Jharkhand is a mineral-rich state of forests, waterfalls and pilgrimage centres that remains less crowded than many Indian holiday belts. Vivance Travels focuses on Ranchi, Deoghar and nature stops with practical road plans.
Here are the top places to visit in Jharkhand:
Ranchi
Ranchi, the capital, is a base for waterfall day trips such as Hundru and Jonha when water flow is good. The city itself offers parks and a cooler plateau climate than the surrounding plains.
Jamshedpur
Jamshedpur is a planned industrial city with parks and a more organised urban layout than many regional centres. It can serve as a comfortable overnight on eastern circuits.
Deoghar
Deoghar is an important pilgrimage town centred on Baba Baidyanath temple. Festival periods are deeply atmospheric but require extra time and patience.
Forest tracts and seasonal falls give Jharkhand its outdoor appeal beyond cities. Trails can be slippery after rain—wear shoes with grip.
Local food is simple and filling, with rice-based meals and regional sweets. Highway restaurants vary in quality; we suggest trusted stops on longer drives.
Markets sell everyday goods and religious souvenirs near temple towns. Handicraft shopping is more limited than in larger tourist states.
October to March is the most comfortable period for touring. Monsoon makes falls dramatic but can complicate rural roads.
How to Reach
Ranchi airport and rail links connect Jharkhand to major metros. Private cars are the best way to reach waterfall viewpoints and pilgrimage towns on one trip.

karnataka.title: Karnataka
karnataka.metaDescription: Tour Karnataka with Vivance Travels—Mysuru, Hampi, Coorg, Bengaluru and custom south-India holiday packages.
karnataka.description: Karnataka spans tech-forward Bengaluru, royal Mysuru, coffee highlands and the stone ruins of Hampi. Vivance Travels builds south-India routes that mix heritage, nature and good food without rushed transfers.

sections.text: Karnataka spans tech-forward Bengaluru, royal Mysuru, coffee highlands and the stone ruins of Hampi. Vivance Travels builds south-India routes that mix heritage, nature and good food without rushed transfers.
Here are the top places to visit in Karnataka:
Mysore
Mysuru is known for its palace, Chamundi Hill and a walkable heritage quarter that suits a two-night stay. Illumination evenings at the palace are popular when scheduled.
Belgaum
Belagavi (Belgaum) and the northern districts work as gateways toward Goa or interior Karnataka. They are practical rather than primary sightseeing bases for most holiday travellers.
Bellary
The Ballari region is the access point for Hampi, where boulder landscapes and Vijayanagara ruins create one of India's great heritage sites. Sunrise and sunset viewpoints are worth planning around.
Bengaluru offers parks, museums and a strong café culture between longer touring days. Use it for international flight connections and a soft landing on arrival.
Coorg (Kodagu) brings coffee estates, misty hills and waterfall walks for a nature-focused interlude. Homestays and estate lodges define the accommodation style here.
Karnataka's food ranges from Bengaluru's global menus to Mysuru's traditional vegetarian meals and coastal seafood in the west. Try local filter coffee wherever you stop.
Pick up Mysore silk, Channapatna toys and coffee from estate shops. Hampi and Mysuru markets also stock stone crafts and light souvenirs.
October to March is ideal for heritage circuits; Coorg is greenest around monsoon but trails may be wet. Summers are hot in Hampi—start early.
How to Reach
Bengaluru, Mangaluru, Hubballi and Mysuru airports support different routes. Rail and road links are strong; Hampi is best reached by road from Hosapete.

kerala.title: Kerala
kerala.metaDescription: Plan Kerala holidays with Vivance Travels—Alleppey houseboats, Kochi, Munnar, Thekkady and tailored backwater itineraries.
kerala.description: Kerala pairs backwaters, hills and coastline with a strong tradition of hospitality and Ayurveda. Vivance Travels designs holidays around houseboats, wildlife and beach time at a comfortable pace.

sections.text: Kerala pairs backwaters, hills and coastline with a strong tradition of hospitality and Ayurveda. Vivance Travels designs holidays around houseboats, wildlife and beach time at a comfortable pace.
Here are the top places to visit in Kerala:
Alleppey
Alappuzha (Alleppey) is the classic base for backwater cruises through canals and village shores. An overnight houseboat stay is the signature experience when water levels allow.
Kochi
Kochi mixes colonial-era Fort Kochi streets, harbour views and a convenient airport for many Kerala arrivals. Art cafés and Chinese fishing nets make for an easy first evening.
Thekkady
Thekkady, beside Periyar, is known for spice scents, lake-edge forests and guided nature walks. Boat rides on the reservoir are popular when operations are running.
Munnar's tea-covered hills offer cool air and plantation viewpoints after humid coastal days. Short walks among tea bushes are suitable for most fitness levels.
Kovalam, Varkala and other coastal stretches add beach time to a Kerala circuit. Choose quieter shores if you prefer less commercial settings.
Kerala cuisine highlights coconut, seafood, banana chips and gently spiced vegetarian meals called sadya on special occasions. Try local toddy-shop style fish curries where appropriate.
Ayurveda centres range from serious treatment programmes to lighter wellness massages. We match centres to your goals and medical comfort level.
How to Reach
October to March is the most popular touring season. Monsoon appeals to wellness travellers but can limit wildlife sightings and some outdoor plans.
Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram and Kozhikode airports cover north–south routes. Houseboat jetties and hill transfers are arranged by road; Vivance itineraries keep drive times realistic.
Recommended Kerala Tour Packages

lakshadweep.title: Lakshadweep
lakshadweep.metaDescription: Visit Lakshadweep with Vivance Travels—Agatti, Bangaram, lagoon stays and permit-assisted island holidays.
lakshadweep.description: Lakshadweep is a coral-island union territory where turquoise lagoons and marine life take centre stage. Vivance Travels helps with permits, island choice and water-activity planning for a smooth island holiday.

sections.text: Lakshadweep is a coral-island union territory where turquoise lagoons and marine life take centre stage. Vivance Travels helps with permits, island choice and water-activity planning for a smooth island holiday.
Here are the top places to visit in Lakshadweep:
Minicoy Island
Minicoy, toward the south of the chain, has a distinctive seafaring culture and lighthouse views. Access and stay options are more limited than on the primary tourist islands.
Agatti Islands
Agatti is a common air gateway with lagoon views and a practical base for transfers. Water clarity here already hints at what deeper island stays offer.
Kavaratti, the administrative centre, offers lagoons, a marine aquarium and a more settled island-town feel. It suits travellers who want services close at hand.
Bangaram Island
Bangaram is prized for its unspoiled lagoon setting and water sports in season. Stays are intimate—book early for popular dates.
Kayaking, snorkelling and glass-bottom boat rides are the main activities on permitted islands. Always follow local marine guidelines to protect coral.
Reef fish, turtles and seasonal marine life make underwater time the highlight for many visitors. Certified dive trips depend on operator schedules and weather.
Meals are island-simple, with seafood and coconut featuring heavily. Dietary needs should be shared in advance because supply boats set the menu rhythm.
Entry to Lakshadweep requires permits arranged through authorised channels. We handle documentation timelines so your flights and stays align.
October to mid-May is generally preferred for calmer seas. Monsoon restricts water activities and some connections.
Island communities maintain distinct traditions and a quieter daily pace than mainland beach resorts. Dress modestly away from swim areas.
How to Reach
Agatti airport is the main air link from Kochi and other cities, with boat transfers to neighbouring islands. Schedules can shift with weather—buffer time is essential.

madhya-pradesh.title: Madhya Pradesh
madhya-pradesh.metaDescription: Explore Madhya Pradesh with Vivance Travels—Khajuraho, wildlife parks, Gwalior fort and central-India heritage tours.
madhya-pradesh.description: Madhya Pradesh sits at India's centre with tiger reserves, historic forts and the sculpted temples of Khajuraho. Vivance Travels connects wildlife and heritage on efficient central-India routes.

sections.text: Madhya Pradesh sits at India's centre with tiger reserves, historic forts and the sculpted temples of Khajuraho. Vivance Travels connects wildlife and heritage on efficient central-India routes.
Here are the top places to visit in Madhya Pradesh:
Bhopal
Bhopal, built around lakes, is a practical hub with museums and access to nearby Sanchi. It works well at the start of a heritage-and-wildlife circuit.
Indore
Indore is a commercial city known for its food scene and as a gateway toward Mandu's plateau ruins. Evening snack walks are part of the local culture.
Gwalior
Gwalior's fort dominates the skyline and rewards a half-day of palaces, temples and viewpoints. The city links easily with northbound or southbound road plans.
Khajuraho's temples and parks such as Kanha or Bandhavgarh define many MP holidays. We avoid overpacking safari mornings with long cultural transfers on the same day.
Regional food includes poha-style breakfasts, street snacks in Indore and hearty vegetarian thalis inland. Spice levels are adjustable in most tourist restaurants.
How to Reach
Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Khajuraho and Gwalior airports support different entry points. Rail is strong across the state; safari zones are best reached by road.

maharashtra.title: Maharashtra
maharashtra.metaDescription: Travel Maharashtra with Vivance Travels—Mumbai, Ajanta Ellora, Lonavala, Mahabaleshwar and custom west-India tours.
maharashtra.description: Maharashtra stretches from Mumbai's coastline to the Western Ghats, cave temples and high plateau cities. Vivance Travels balances city energy with hill stations and heritage sites such as Ajanta and Ellora.

sections.text: Maharashtra stretches from Mumbai's coastline to the Western Ghats, cave temples and high plateau cities. Vivance Travels balances city energy with hill stations and heritage sites such as Ajanta and Ellora.
Here are the top places to visit in Maharashtra:
Aurangabad
Aurangabad is the base for Ajanta and Ellora, two outstanding rock-cut complexes best visited on separate days. Early entries help you avoid heat and larger groups.
Lonavala
Lonavala and nearby Khandala are popular Western Ghats getaways with viewpoints and monsoon waterfalls. They work as short breaks from Mumbai or Pune.
Mahabaleshwar
Mahabaleshwar offers strawberry farms in season, lake views and cooler plateau air. Map viewpoints across a full day rather than rushing between every overlook.
Mumbai is India's high-energy coastal metropolis—gateway flights, colonial architecture, street food and seafront walks. We keep first-day plans light after long-haul arrivals.
Maharashtrian thalis, vada pav and coastal seafood are culinary highlights. Mumbai's restaurant scene also covers cuisines from across India and beyond.
The Konkan coast adds quieter beaches and temple towns south of Mumbai. Road and rail journeys here are scenic but can be slow—plan overnight stops.
Shopping ranges from Mumbai boutiques and Crawford Market energy to hill-station jams and honey. Keep receipts for higher-value textiles and jewellery.
October to March suits most sightseeing; monsoon is dramatic in the Ghats but wet underfoot. Summers are hot inland and humid on the coast.
Ajanta's paintings and Ellora's Kailasa temple are among India's finest artistic achievements in stone. Guides make the iconography far more rewarding.
Allow buffer time around cave visits—security lines and walking distances add up. Carry water and wear shoes suitable for steps.
How to Reach
Mumbai, Pune, Aurangabad and Nagpur airports cover major circuits. The rail network is extensive; private cars remain best for Ghats viewpoints and cave days.

manipur.title: Manipur
manipur.metaDescription: Discover Manipur with Vivance Travels—Imphal, Loktak Lake, Ukhrul hills and guided north-east holiday plans.
manipur.description: Manipur is a north-eastern state of lakes, hills and distinctive classical dance traditions. Vivance Travels plans Imphal-centred holidays with respectful cultural visits and realistic hill-road timing.

sections.text: Manipur is a north-eastern state of lakes, hills and distinctive classical dance traditions. Vivance Travels plans Imphal-centred holidays with respectful cultural visits and realistic hill-road timing.
Here are the top places to visit in Manipur:
Imphal
Imphal is the main base, with markets, war cemeteries and access to nearby cultural sites. It is also where most flights arrive for Manipur journeys.
Ukhrul
Ukhrul and the surrounding hills offer cooler air and scenic drives for travellers who want landscapes beyond the capital. Road conditions vary—we plan daylight transfers only.
Bishnupur
Bishnupur district is known for temples and access toward Loktak's wider wetland region. It pairs well with a nature-focused day from Imphal.
Loktak Lake, with its floating phumdis, is Manipur's signature natural sight. Boat arrangements depend on local regulations and season.
Manipuri cuisine includes aromatic vegetarian dishes, fish preparations and distinctive herbs. Try local specialties in established restaurants rather than unknown roadside stops at night.
Classical dance, polo heritage and handloom textiles are cultural strengths of the state. Ask before photographing people or ceremonies.
October to April is generally preferred for clearer weather and easier road travel. Always check current local advisories before departure.
How to Reach
Imphal airport connects to major Indian cities. Inner-line permits may be required for some travellers—we confirm requirements for your nationality and route.

meghalaya.title: Meghalaya
meghalaya.metaDescription: Explore Meghalaya with Vivance Travels—Shillong, Cherrapunji, living root bridges and custom north-east nature trips.
meghalaya.description: Meghalaya is known for living root bridges, high rainfall landscapes and the plateau town of Shillong. Vivance Travels builds walking-friendly itineraries that respect trail difficulty and weather.

sections.text: Meghalaya is known for living root bridges, high rainfall landscapes and the plateau town of Shillong. Vivance Travels builds walking-friendly itineraries that respect trail difficulty and weather.
Here are the top places to visit in Meghalaya:
Mawlynnong Village
Mawlynnong is often visited for its community-kept cleanliness and village paths. Combine it with nearby root-bridge walks rather than treating it as a standalone rush stop.
Laitlum Canyon
Laitlum Canyon offers wide valley views on clear days and is a favourite for open-sky photography. Winds can be strong—dress in layers.
Double Decker
The double-decker living root bridge near Nongriat is a highlight for fit walkers ready for many steps. Start early and carry water; the return climb is demanding.
Shillong provides cafés, viewpoints and a comfortable base between wetter southern destinations. Ward's Lake and local music culture add easy urban interest.
Single-span living root bridges appear in several Khasi villages and show how communities shape forest paths over decades. Hire local guides on village trails.
Meghalayan food includes jadoh rice dishes, smoked meats and simple vegetarian plates. Shillong's café scene also offers familiar international options.
Rain is part of Meghalaya's identity—pack waterproofs even in drier months. Trails become slippery quickly after showers.
October to April is popular for clearer views; monsoon is atmospheric but can limit canyon and bridge walks. Check trail status after heavy rain.
Caves such as those around Cherrapunji (Sohra) add another dimension for travellers interested in geology. Guided entry is recommended.
Respect village rules on litter and plastic—communities here take cleanliness seriously. Carry reusable bottles where refill points exist.
How to Reach

Flights arrive via Guwahati or Shillong's airport when schedules allow, with road transfers into the Khasi and Jaintia hills. Private vehicles handle steep sections more comfortably than rushed shared taxis.

mizoram.title: Mizoram
mizoram.metaDescription: Visit Mizoram with Vivance Travels—Aizawl views, Champhai hills and permit-assisted north-east holidays.
mizoram.description: Mizoram is a hill state of bamboo forests, ridgeline towns and a calm daily pace. Vivance Travels arranges permits and scenic drives for travellers seeking a quieter north-east experience.

sections.text: Mizoram is a hill state of bamboo forests, ridgeline towns and a calm daily pace. Vivance Travels arranges permits and scenic drives for travellers seeking a quieter north-east experience.
Mizo culture emphasises community, music and distinctive woven textiles. Travellers who move slowly and dress modestly tend to feel most welcome.
Here are the top places to visit in Mizoram:
Aizawl
Aizawl, built along ridges, offers sweeping views and markets that introduce local life. It is the main arrival city and planning base.
Champhai
Champhai sits near the Myanmar border landscapes with open valley scenery. It suits travellers who enjoy long views more than monument checklists.
Lunglei
Lunglei and southern routes feel even quieter, with forested hills and small-town stays. Road hours add up—we keep daily distances sensible.
Expect rice-based meals, boiled vegetables and meat dishes in many eateries. Vegetarian options exist but are simpler than in larger Indian tourist states.
Chapchar Kut and other festivals showcase dance and community gatherings when dates align with your trip. Confirm event calendars before you travel.
October to March is the most comfortable period for hill touring. Monsoon landslides can affect schedules.
Handloom shawls and bamboo crafts make meaningful souvenirs when bought from local cooperatives. Ask about fair pricing rather than hard bargaining.
How to Reach
Aizawl's airport connects to Kolkata and Guwahati among other cities. Inner-line permits are required for many visitors—we process these before arrival where possible.

nagaland.title: Nagaland
nagaland.metaDescription: Experience Nagaland with Vivance Travels—Kohima, Hornbill Festival dates, hill villages and guided north-east tours.
nagaland.description: Nagaland is known for ridgeline villages, tribal heritage and the Hornbill Festival's seasonal energy. Vivance Travels plans culturally respectful itineraries around Kohima, Dimapur and the hills.

sections.text: Nagaland is known for ridgeline villages, tribal heritage and the Hornbill Festival's seasonal energy. Vivance Travels plans culturally respectful itineraries around Kohima, Dimapur and the hills.
Here are the top places to visit in Nagaland:
Dimapur
Dimapur is the main rail and air gateway, more commercial than scenic. Most travellers move onward to Kohima the same day.
Kohima
Kohima, the capital, offers war cemetery history, markets and access to surrounding Angami villages. It is the usual base for first-time visitors.
Mokukchung
Mokokchung and other districts introduce different tribal traditions and quieter hill towns. Travel times are long relative to map distances.
The Hornbill Festival (when held at Kisama) concentrates music, craft and dance into a few peak days each winter. Book stays far in advance for festival dates.
Naga cuisine is known for smoked meats, bamboo shoot flavours and robust spice. Vegetarian travellers should brief hotels ahead of arrival.
Village visits should be arranged with local consent and guides who understand community protocols. Never enter ceremonial spaces uninvited.
November to March is preferred for clearer weather and festival travel. Monsoon reduces road reliability.
Shawls, woodcraft and beadwork are popular purchases from authorised craft centres. Festival stalls are lively but can be crowded.
How to Reach
Dimapur airport and rail station feed most itineraries, with road transfers into the hills. Permits may apply—requirements depend on nationality and route.

odisha.title: Odisha
odisha.metaDescription: Tour Odisha with Vivance Travels—Puri, Konark, Bhubaneswar temples and custom eastern-India heritage holidays.
odisha.description: Odisha combines temple architecture, classical dance roots and a long Bay of Bengal coastline. Vivance Travels links Bhubaneswar, Puri and Konark with crafts and nature stops at a steady pace.

sections.text: Odisha combines temple architecture, classical dance roots and a long Bay of Bengal coastline. Vivance Travels links Bhubaneswar, Puri and Konark with crafts and nature stops at a steady pace.
Here are the top places to visit in Odisha:
Bhubaneswar
Bhubaneswar is often called a city of temples, with Lingaraj and other historic shrines set among a modern capital. It is the main air hub for Odisha holidays.
Cuttack
Cuttack, on the Mahanadi, is known for silver filigree work and a more traditional urban texture. It pairs easily with a Bhubaneswar stay.
Sambalpur
Sambalpur and western Odisha open toward forests, waterfalls and different craft traditions. These routes suit travellers with extra days beyond the coastal temple triangle.
Puri's beach and Jagannath Temple, together with Konark's Sun Temple, form Odisha's classic coastal circuit. Respect temple entry rules for non-Hindu visitors where they apply.
Odia meals feature rice, dalma, seafood on the coast and distinctive sweets such as chhena-based desserts. Temple town eateries can be busy at peak pilgrimage times.
Applique work from Pipli, stone carving and ikat textiles are signature crafts. Government emporiums are reliable if you want fixed prices.
October to March is ideal for temple and beach time. Summers are hot; monsoon brings rough seas but green countryside.
Classical dance traditions such as Odissi have deep roots here. An evening performance, when available, adds context to temple architecture.
How to Reach
Bhubaneswar airport and a strong rail network serve the state. Road transfers cover Puri and Konark comfortably in day trips or short overnights.

puducherry.title: Puducherry
puducherry.metaDescription: Stay in Puducherry with Vivance Travels—French Quarter, Promenade, Auroville and relaxed coastal getaways.
puducherry.description: Puducherry (Pondicherry) blends a seaside promenade, French-quarter streets and nearby Auroville's experimental community. Vivance Travels designs easy coastal breaks with heritage walks and café time.

sections.text: Puducherry (Pondicherry) blends a seaside promenade, French-quarter streets and nearby Auroville's experimental community. Vivance Travels designs easy coastal breaks with heritage walks and café time.
Here are the top places to visit in Puducherry:
Shri Aurobindo Ghosh Ashram
Sri Aurobindo Ashram is a central spiritual address in town, visited by many travellers for its calm courtyards. Quiet behaviour is expected in and around the ashram.
Pondicherry Museum
The Pondicherry Museum holds archaeological finds and colonial-era objects that help explain the territory's layered past. It is a compact indoor stop on hot afternoons.
Botanical Garden
The Botanical Garden offers shaded paths close to the city centre. Families often use it as a low-key break between beach and heritage walks.
The Beach Road promenade is Puducherry's evening social spine, with sea air and colonial façades. Sunrise visits are quieter than sunset crowds.
Auroville, just outside town, is known for the Matrimandir viewing point and experimental community projects. Visitor rules for the inner chamber are specific—we brief you in advance.
Cafés serve French-influenced bakes alongside south-Indian meals and seafood. Dietary variety is one of Puducherry's practical advantages.
The French Quarter's mustard-and-white streets are ideal for bicycle or walking tours. Many heritage homes now host boutique stays and galleries.
November to March is the most pleasant period. Weekends and holidays draw visitors from Chennai—midweek stays feel calmer.
How to Reach
Chennai airport is the usual international gateway, with a road transfer of a few hours. Puducherry also has limited rail and bus links for lighter travellers.

punjab.title: Punjab
punjab.metaDescription: Visit Punjab with Vivance Travels—Amritsar Golden Temple, Wagah border, Punjabi cuisine and north-India city breaks.
punjab.description: Punjab is a land of fertile fields, robust hospitality and the Golden Temple's spiritual calm in Amritsar. Vivance Travels focuses on meaningful pilgrimage time, food and easy city links.

sections.text: Punjab is a land of fertile fields, robust hospitality and the Golden Temple's spiritual calm in Amritsar. Vivance Travels focuses on meaningful pilgrimage time, food and easy city links.
Here are the top places to visit in Punjab:
Amritsar
Amritsar centres on Harmandir Sahib (the Golden Temple), where the langar tradition welcomes visitors of all backgrounds. Cover your head and follow shrine etiquette during your visit.
Chandigarh
Chandigarh, shared as a capital with Haryana, often appears on Punjab itineraries for gardens and modernist architecture. It is a comfortable overnight between hill and plains journeys.
Jalandhar
Jalandhar and other cities reflect Punjab's commercial energy and sports culture. They are useful transit points more than primary sightseeing bases.
Punjabi food—butter-rich breads, grilled meats, vegetarian thalis and lassi—is a highlight of any trip. Amritsar's old-city eateries are especially popular.
The Golden Temple complex is as much about community service and music as about architecture. An evening visit when the shrine is illuminated is memorable.
Shopping includes phulkari embroidery, juttis and dry fruits. Markets near the temple can be crowded—keep belongings secure.
October to March is ideal for city walks and border ceremonies. Summers are hot on the plains.
How to Reach
Amritsar and Chandigarh airports serve most visitors, with excellent highway links across the state. The Wagah border ceremony requires timing and patience in peak season.

rajasthan.title: Rajasthan
rajasthan.metaDescription: Tour Rajasthan with Vivance Travels—Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer and custom palace-and-desert holidays.
rajasthan.description: Rajasthan is India's classic fort-and-palace circuit, from Jaipur's pink-hued streets to Udaipur's lakes and Jaisalmer's desert edge. Vivance Travels paces royal cities so you enjoy heritage without constant packing.

sections.text: Rajasthan is India's classic fort-and-palace circuit, from Jaipur's pink-hued streets to Udaipur's lakes and Jaisalmer's desert edge. Vivance Travels paces royal cities so you enjoy heritage without constant packing.
Here are the top places to visit in Rajasthan:
Jaipur
Jaipur combines Amber Fort, City Palace and lively bazaars in a single energetic capital. We schedule fort visits earlier in the day to manage heat and queues.
Udaipur
Udaipur's lakes and palaces create a softer, more romantic atmosphere than the desert cities. Boat rides on Lake Pichola depend on water levels and local rules.
Jodhpur
Jodhpur's blue-washed lanes beneath Mehrangarh Fort are ideal for guided walks and rooftop views. The fort museum alone can fill a half day.
Jaisalmer rises from the Thar with a living fort town and desert camps on the dunes. Choose camps for comfort standards and responsible tourism practices.
Pushkar and Bikaner add pilgrimage colour and camel-country heritage to longer Rajasthan routes. Festival dates can transform these towns—book early if you target them.
Rajasthani cuisine features dal baati churma, gatte ki sabzi and sweets such as ghewar in season. Desert towns also serve hearty non-vegetarian specialties.
Look for block prints, blue pottery, jewellery and leatherwork from reputable stores. Jaipur and Jodhpur are the strongest shopping bases.
Hill forts and desert citadels tell stories of Rajput history better with a guide. Audio guides are a fallback when private guiding is unavailable.
October to March is peak season for pleasant days and clear skies. Summers are extreme in the desert; monsoon brings relief but humid afternoons.
How to Reach
Jaipur, Udaipur, Jodhpur and Jaisalmer airports support fly-in circuits. Road journeys between cities are part of the experience—we avoid unrealistic same-day fort marathons.
Recommended Rajasthan Tour Packages

sikkim.title: Sikkim
sikkim.metaDescription: Holiday in Sikkim with Vivance Travels—Gangtok, Tsomgo Lake, monasteries and permit-ready Himalayan itineraries.
sikkim.description: Sikkim is a compact Himalayan state of monasteries, alpine views and carefully protected landscapes. Vivance Travels handles permits and mountain pacing for Gangtok-based holidays and beyond.

sections.text: Sikkim is a compact Himalayan state of monasteries, alpine views and carefully protected landscapes. Vivance Travels handles permits and mountain pacing for Gangtok-based holidays and beyond.
Here are the top places to visit in Sikkim:
Pemayangtse Monastery
Pemayangtse Monastery in West Sikkim is among the state's important Buddhist centres, with mountain views on clear days. Combine it with Pelling stays for sunrises toward Kanchenjunga.
Kanchendzonga National Park
Khangchendzonga National Park landscapes define Sikkim's wilderness identity, with trekking routes for prepared walkers. Park rules and seasonal access apply.
Gangtok is the main base, with monasteries, viewpoints and a walkable MG Marg. It is where most travellers organise permits for high-lake excursions.
Tsango Lake
Tsomgo (Changu) Lake is a popular high-altitude day trip from Gangtok when roads and permits allow. Dress warmly—temperatures drop quickly at elevation.
Nathula Pass visits depend on permits, weather and weekday restrictions. We only include it when approvals and road status are realistic for your dates.
Sikkimese food includes momos, thukpa, fermented flavours and simple vegetarian plates. Try local tea and seasonal produce in Gangtok cafés.
Monasteries across East and West Sikkim reward quiet visits early in the day. Photography rules vary—follow posted guidance.
March to May and October to mid-December are favoured for views. Monsoon landslides can disrupt plans; winter brings cold and occasional road closures.
Permits are required for many high-altitude and border-proximate sights. Carry passport copies and follow your guide's briefing at checkpoints.
How to Reach
Bagdogra airport and New Jalpaiguri station in West Bengal are the usual gateways, followed by a mountain drive to Gangtok. Shared jeeps and private cars are the standard options.
Recommended Sikkim Tour Packages

tamil-nadu.title: Tamil Nadu
tamil-nadu.metaDescription: Explore Tamil Nadu with Vivance Travels—Chennai, Madurai, Mahabalipuram, Ooty and custom south-India temple tours.
tamil-nadu.description: Tamil Nadu showcases Dravidian temple architecture, classical arts and a long coastline from Chennai to Kanyakumari. Vivance Travels builds temple-and-hill itineraries with sensible driving days.

sections.text: Tamil Nadu showcases Dravidian temple architecture, classical arts and a long coastline from Chennai to Kanyakumari. Vivance Travels builds temple-and-hill itineraries with sensible driving days.
Here are the top places to visit in Tamil Nadu:
Chennai
Chennai is the cultural and air gateway, with Marina Beach, museums and strong connections to the rest of the state. Use it for arrival rest before temple-town journeys.
Coimbatore
Coimbatore anchors western Tamil Nadu and is the usual approach to the Nilgiri hills. It is more commercial than touristic, but practical for overnight stops.
Mahabalipuram
Mahabalipuram's shore temples and rock-cut monuments sit on the Coromandel coast and are ideal for a half- or full-day heritage visit from Chennai. Sunrise on the shore is especially atmospheric.
Madurai's Meenakshi Amman Temple is one of south India's great living temple complexes. Plan enough time for the halls, tanks and evening ceremonies when open to visitors.
Ooty and Kodaikanal offer cooler hill escapes with lakes and colonial-era charm. They balance hot plains temple days on longer Tamil Nadu circuits.
Tamil cuisine ranges from filter coffee and dosas to Chettinad spice and temple-town vegetarian meals. Spice levels can be adjusted if you ask early.
Towering gopurams and temple tanks define the state's visual identity. A local guide helps with mythology and photography etiquette inside active shrines.
Shopping highlights include Kanchipuram silks, bronze work and fragrant jasmine garlands in season. Buy silk from established dealers when investing in heavier pieces.
November to February is comfortable for plains sightseeing; hill stations work year-round with packing for rain or chill. Summers are hot and humid on the coast.
Classical music and Bharatanatyam traditions remain part of cultural life in larger cities. Check performance calendars if the arts interest you.
How to Reach
Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai and Tiruchirappalli airports support multi-city routes. Trains are excellent between temple towns; private cars help when linking coast and hills.

telangana.title: Telangana
telangana.metaDescription: Visit Telangana with Vivance Travels—Hyderabad Charminar, Golconda, Warangal forts and Deccan city breaks.
telangana.description: Telangana, with Hyderabad at its heart, mixes historic Islamic architecture, modern city life and Deccan landscapes. Vivance Travels plans Hyderabad stays with optional heritage drives to Warangal and beyond.

sections.text: Telangana, with Hyderabad at its heart, mixes historic Islamic architecture, modern city life and Deccan landscapes. Vivance Travels plans Hyderabad stays with optional heritage drives to Warangal and beyond.
Here are the top places to visit in Telangana:
Hyderabad
Hyderabad is known for Charminar, Golconda Fort, lakeside views and a celebrated food culture. Old-city walks are best in the morning before heat and traffic build.
Warangal
Warangal preserves Kakatiya-era gateways, temples and fort remains that reward a dedicated day trip or overnight. The sculpture detail is a highlight for heritage travellers.
Warangal's fort precinct and nearby temple sites show a different Deccan story from Hyderabad's Qutb Shahi heritage. Combining both gives a fuller historical picture.
Karimnagar
Karimnagar and northern districts suit travellers extending into less-visited Telangana countryside. Facilities are simpler than in Hyderabad—we plan stays accordingly.
Hyderabadi biryani, haleem in season and Irani cafés are culinary signatures. Vegetarian and global options are widely available in the newer city.
Pearls, bidriware and textiles are popular purchases. Buy pearls from reputable jewellers and ask for documentation on higher-value items.
How to Reach

Rajiv Gandhi International Airport is a major hub, with strong rail and road links across the Deccan. Hyderabad traffic can be heavy—we schedule monument visits outside peak congestion where possible.

tripura.title: Tripura
tripura.metaDescription: Discover Tripura with Vivance Travels—Agartala, Udaipur temples, Neermahal and quiet north-east getaways.
tripura.description: Tripura is a north-eastern state of palaces, temples and forested hills that still sees fewer leisure travellers. Vivance Travels builds Agartala-centred plans with cultural stops and green day trips.

sections.text: Tripura is a north-eastern state of palaces, temples and forested hills that still sees fewer leisure travellers. Vivance Travels builds Agartala-centred plans with cultural stops and green day trips.
Here are the top places to visit in Tripura:
Agartala
Agartala is the capital and main air gateway, with palaces and markets that introduce the state. It is the practical base for most itineraries.
Dharmanagar
Dharmanagar and northern towns offer a quieter pace for travellers continuing toward Assam routes. Road journeys should be planned in daylight.
Udaipur
Udaipur in Tripura is known for temples such as Tripura Sundari and a different atmosphere from the capital. It is a meaningful cultural day trip.
Neermahal, a water palace on Rudrasagar Lake, is one of Tripura's most photogenic landmarks when boat access is operating. Check seasonal water levels.
Tripuri cuisine includes rice, freshwater fish and distinctive bamboo-shoot flavours. Hotel restaurants in Agartala also serve wider Indian menus.
October to March is the most comfortable touring season. Monsoon greenery is attractive but can slow rural roads.
How to Reach
Agartala airport connects to Kolkata and other cities. Border proximity means some areas may have special guidelines—we confirm details for your route.

Here are the top places to visit in Uttar Pradesh:
Agra
Agra is centred on the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort and nearby tombs that repay a full day or more. Sunrise Taj visits are popular—we arrange tickets and timing in advance.
Lucknow
Lucknow offers Nawabi architecture, refined cuisine and a more relaxed city rhythm than the pilgrimage towns. It works well as a cultural interlude on longer UP routes.
Lucknow's imambaras, gardens and craft traditions reward guided walks in the older quarters. Evenings are ideal for tasting local kebabs and vegetarian specialties.
Allahabad
Prayagraj (Allahabad) sits at a sacred river confluence and hosts major gatherings in festival cycles. Non-festival visits are calmer for first-time travellers.
Varanasi's riverfront ghats are among India's most powerful travel experiences, best approached with a guide at dawn. Boat rides offer perspective on the city's spiritual daily life.
UP cuisine ranges from Agra's sweets and chaat to Awadhi cooking in Lucknow and simple vegetarian meals in pilgrimage towns. Street food is best from busy, well-known stalls.
Crafts include marble inlay souvenirs in Agra, chikankari embroidery in Lucknow and silk in Varanasi. Buy from established shops for higher-value textiles.
October to March is the prime season for sightseeing comfort. Summers are intense; monsoon humidity is high along the rivers.
Spiritual circuits can be emotional and crowded—build quiet time into each day. Dress modestly at temples and riverfront ceremonies.
How to Reach

Airports at Agra, Lucknow, Varanasi and Prayagraj support fly-drive plans, while the Golden Triangle road/rail link from Delhi remains popular for Agra. Private cars help when combining multiple sacred cities.

Here are the top places to visit in Uttarakhand:
Dehradun
Dehradun is the capital gateway with a pleasant valley setting and access to Mussoorie and the plains. Many travellers overnight here at the start or end of hill journeys.
Rishikesh, beside the Ganga, is known for yoga ashrams, evening aarti and adventure sports such as rafting in season. It pairs naturally with Haridwar on spiritual circuits.
Mussoorie
Mussoorie offers colonial-era charm, ridge walks and views over Dehradun valley. The Mall Road is lively; quieter trails sit a short drive away.
Nainital and the lake district provide boating, viewpoints and a classic family hill-station atmosphere. Weekends are busy—midweek stays feel more spacious.
Haridwar
Haridwar's ghats and temples draw pilgrims year-round, with Ganga aarti as a focal evening ritual. Expect crowds during major festival periods.
Char Dham routes (Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, Badrinath) are seasonal pilgrimage undertakings needing fitness awareness and buffer days. We plan only when road and weather windows are suitable.
Jim Corbett Tiger Reserve is a flagship wildlife stop in the state's foothills. Safari zones and lodge choices should match your wildlife priorities.
Garhwali and Kumaoni meals are simple and comforting—lentils, flatbreads and mountain vegetables. Rishikesh also has extensive café and vegetarian options.
Adventure options include rafting, easy treks and camping in designated areas. We match activities to age groups and experience levels.
March to June and September to November are popular for hills and wildlife. Monsoon can trigger landslides; winter brings snow to higher destinations.
Markets in Mussoorie and Nainital sell woollens, souvenirs and local preserves. Quality varies—compare a few shops for woollens and walking gear.
How to Reach
Dehradun and Pantnagar airports, plus Haridwar and Kathgodam railheads, serve different circuits. Mountain roads need daylight driving and flexible timing in bad weather.

Here are the top places to visit in West Bengal:
West Bengal's appeal lies in contrast—colonial and contemporary Kolkata, Himalayan tea ridges and delta wildlife. We help you choose a focus rather than overstuffing one short trip.
Darjeeling
Darjeeling is known for tea estates, mountain views toward Kanchenjunga on clear mornings and the heritage toy train sections when operating. Early starts improve your chance of sunrise vistas.
Bankura
Bankura and the wider Rarh region interest travellers seeking terracotta temples and rural landscapes. These stops suit slower cultural itineraries beyond the usual hill-and-city route.
Bishnupur's terracotta temple panels are a highlight for art and architecture enthusiasts. A guide helps decode the narrative reliefs.
Murshidabad recalls Nawabi history along the Bhagirathi with palaces and gardens. It works as a heritage extension from Kolkata when time allows.
Murshidabad
Kolkata offers museums, riverfront walks, bookshops and a celebrated food culture from street snacks to old clubs and modern restaurants. It is the main international gateway for the state.
The Sundarbans mangrove region is explored by boat with licensed operators, with chances to see unique delta wildlife. Trips are tide- and permit-dependent.
Bengali cuisine—fish preparations, sweets such as rosogolla and mishti doi, and vegetarian thalis—is central to the travel experience. Inform hotels about spice and dietary preferences early.
How to Reach
Kolkata airport and a dense rail network support most plans; Bagdogra serves Darjeeling circuits. River and forest journeys need extra schedule flexibility.
